caption: DnaA-box occupancy BY REGION across the succinate cell cycle (5 timepoints) — the chromosome-map view, RESTORED + updated on the current active mechanism (listeners.replication_data, PR #162). Each circular chromosome shows oriC (high+low boxes), dnaA-promoter, chromosomal pool + ter; filled=DnaA-bound, open ring=free. oriC + its boxes double at replication (oriC boxes 11->22, chromosomal 302->604 as the fork copies). Bottom: free DnaA-ATP (nM, via cell volume) vs the 100 nM oriC-low K_d. KEY DIFFERENCE vs the read-only era: the active solve DEPLETES the free pool, so free DnaA-ATP now sits ~5-67 nM (median 45) BELOW the K_d (was pinned ~389 nM above it) and oriC-low occupancy is partial/dynamic (~0.5-0.64), not pinned ~0.8 — the over-binding resolved.
